name: Rod lift and progressing cavity pumps
aliases: Rod lift and progressing cavity pumps
principle: A surface pumping unit moves a sucker-rod string that drives a downhole plunger pump (rod lift), or a rotating rod string drives a progressing cavity pump (PCP). PCPs reach about 1,800 m and 5,000 bbl/d, and aromatics can degrade the elastomer stator.

process_steps.name: Surface unit or rotary drive
equipment: pumping unit or PCP drive head

source.note: Wikipedia, Artificial lift, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

source.note: Wikipedia, Artificial lift, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.metric: rod lift and PCP application envelopes (rate and depth)
performance.unit: ft TVD (sucker rod pump 100-10,000; liquid rate up to 5,000 blpd)
performance.basis: IPIECA Energy Efficiency Compendium artificial-lift table: sucker rod pump 5,000 blpd, 100-10,000 ft TVD; rod-driven elastomeric PCP 5-5,000 blpd, 100-9,000 ft; rod-driven metal-to-metal PCP 350-2,500 blpd, 100-3,500 ft; electric submersible PCP 5-5,000 blpd, 100-8,000 ft

source.note: IPIECA Energy Efficiency Compendium, Artificial lift (2023), Table 1 (read 2026-10-28)

advantages: Simple and low cost at low rates
limitations: Depth and rate limits; aromatics degrade PCP stators
